payload.title: Close ClayCode BASE blockers on real Ubuntu target
payload.work_clay: On the Andreas Ubuntu developer system, pull current main and execute the production ClayCode chain source/front-end -> deterministic canonical IR -> type/effect -> evaluator -> compiler/lowering -> runtime/ABI/FFI -> Ubuntu execution. Use research_entity/claycode/CLAYCODE_RELEASE_WORKSPACE.json as the exact 14-package acceptance surface. Repair implementation defects rather than weakening gates. Then execute the mandatory application proof suite (CLI, HTTP_WEBSITE, DB_SERVICE, CONCURRENT_SERVICE, GUI_INTERACTIVE, COMPILER_TOOL, GPU_ML_NUMERICAL, SYSTEM_EFFECT_SANDBOX, FRANK_COMPONENT, FULL_FRANK_HANDOFF), fuzz/conformance/differential suites, corpus/heldout checks and harness handoff. Emit exact hashes and local execution receipts for every passed subgate; preserve failures/negative results. Do not mark a work package PASS from representability, prose, proxy tests or unexecuted code.
payload.reason_clay: BASE currently has 14 OPEN work packages and zero recorded application passes. GitHub CI can validate repository-generic semantics, but Frank v0.1 BASE explicitly requires Ubuntu developer-system execution receipts for host/runtime/application claims. Local execution is therefore the discriminating truth surface.
payload.completion_clay: Complete only when every CC-WP-01..14 acceptance condition has a reproducible receipt, all ten mandatory application proofs execute on Ubuntu, CLAYCODE_GENERAL_PURPOSE_COMPILER_MANIFEST.json is generated from evidence, unresolved language counterexamples are zero or explicitly blocking, and CLAYCODE_RELEASE_GATE plus GENERAL_PURPOSE_GATE may be set PASS without weakening any acceptance rule. Otherwise emit failure receipts and keep affected packages OPEN.
payload.executor_policy: prefer_verified_CLAUDE_CODE_LOCAL_ORGAN_for_local_build_run_test_and_repair; may use local deterministic tools and free model workers where useful; never weaken safety/authority or evidence gates
